primary.title: Step-by-step guide to file ITR online: Know the complete process from registration to verification
primary.summary: Filing an ITR involves following a series of steps to ensure all details are reported accurately. The Income Tax Department provides a pre-filled ITR-1 filing service on the e-Filing portal for registered users. This guide covers the step-by-step process of filing the ITR-1 form.
